name: Kimi no Tonari de Koishiteru! ~The Respective Happiness~
original_name: キミのとなりで恋してる！ 〜 The Respective Happiness 〜
source:
This is the fandisc for Kimi no Tonari de Koi Shiteru!, featuring after stories for each of the three heroines, Nagisa, Rina and Ryouka. It also includes several side stories.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Kimi no Tonari de Koi Shiteru!》的同人光盘，收录了三位女主人公渚、莉娜和凉香的后续故事。它还包括几个支线故事。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
